newsitem.title: USA: Travelers Life, Summit set joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Travelers Life, Summit set joint venture.

text.p: Travelers Life and Annuity Co of Travelers Group Inc said it had established a joint marketing venture with Summit Bancorp to provide the bank's customers with term life insurance.
Travelers said it would distribute information about term life insurance to Summit's checking account customers this month.
It said it would make another marketing campaign to the customers in early 1997.
Over the past two years, Travelers said it had been involved in a number of similar joint marketing ventures with banks of all sizes.
Summit Bancorp is New Jersey's largest independent bank, with total assets of $22 billion.
Travelers Life and Annuity Co provided life insurance, long-term care insurance and annuities.
